configuration.probe_direction: mine-vs-theirs direction from each layer's lightweight board probe
configuration.score: Mean absolute legality-gradient projection on capture-supporting squares divided by mean absolute projection on unrelated occupied controls.
configuration.capture_set: Union of capture-line opponent squares and friendly terminators.
configuration.sampling: The sampled legality-position set from notebook section 15: random legal Othello games, prefix lengths between 12 and 45, duplicate prefixes skipped, selected legal move chosen by maximizing flipped pieces, then number of capture lines, then lower token id.
